Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

trainingmodels 0.0.2

  • New srpe_load() computes session RPE load, RPE x duration (Foster 1998; Foster et al. 2001).
  • New rolling_load() gives the rolling sum and mean of the daily load over a window of days, and monotony_strain() gives Foster’s monotony and strain over a rolling window (7 days by default). Both work within each athlete, return NA for windows with a missing day, and offer both timing options through same_day_load, with default "include" (DECISIONS.md, D-020 to D-022).
  • Functions that take a daily_load now check it first and refuse an object that was changed after it was built, for example by subsetting (#4).
  • New article “Monotony and strain” reproduces Foster (1998, Table 1) and discusses the limitations of the descriptors.
  • Ratios of rolling loads and EWMA-based loads are left to the ACWR package (D-019).

trainingmodels 0.0.1

  • New as_daily_load() builds a complete daily calendar from session data: same-day sessions are summed, every day is marked as training, rest or missing, and days without a row are filled as rest (default) or missing, with a warning for long runs of filled days (DECISIONS.md, D-015 to D-017). Supports several athletes and an optional performance column.
  • New print() and summary() methods for daily_load objects.

trainingmodels 0.0.0.9000

  • Initial package skeleton (milestone 0). No user-facing functionality yet.
